title: Phantom Blade Zero Editions, Price and Pre-Order Bonus - What You Can Still Buy
description: Pre-orders closed at launch on October 29, 2026. What the pre-order bonus was, what each edition contains, current prices on PS5 and PC, and whether the bonus is still obtainable in-game.
keyword: phantom blade zero preorder, phantom blade zero pre order, phantom blade zero editions, phantom blade zero price, phantom blade zero deluxe edition

facts.label: Pre-order bonus
facts.value: Treasure Basin accessory (+10% Remnant Dust drop rate) + Legacy appearance

facts.label: Bonus exclusivity
facts.value: Obtainable in-game; the two Deluxe outfits are labelled exclusive

sections.title: Pre-Orders Are Over - Here Is What That Changes
sections.content:
Pre-orders opened on 11 August 2026 and closed when the game released on 29 October 2026. You can still buy the game; you cannot still buy it early, and the pre-order bonus is no longer tied to a purchase.

That matters less than it sounds. The bonus item, the Treasure Basin accessory, is also obtainable inside the game, so nothing about a late purchase locks you out of a build. The two Deluxe outfits are the only items described as exclusive, and those come with the Deluxe edition rather than with timing.

sections.title: What Each Edition Contains
sections.content:
EditionContentsWho it is for
StandardBase gameAnyone who just wants to play; the deluxe extras are cosmetic and convenience, not content
DeluxeBase game, two outfits labelled exclusive, plus the digital extras bundled in that tierCollectors of cosmetics and anyone who wants the outfit set complete
Physical PS5Not on sale yet - S-GAME says 2027Disc collectors only, and only if you can wait

The upgrade path matters here: in most regions the Deluxe content is sold as a separate upgrade, so buying Standard now and upgrading later costs the same as buying Deluxe up front. There is no reason to decide under time pressure.

sections.title: Is the Deluxe Edition Worth It?
sections.content:
Nothing in the Deluxe tier changes what you can do in the game. There are no exclusive bosses, no weapons behind the paywall, no difficulty gates. If you are choosing on value, Standard is the correct answer and the upgrade can be added whenever you decide you want the outfits.

The one group that should think twice is disc collectors: the boxed PS5 version is a 2027 item, so waiting for it means waiting a year. The physical edition page covers what is and is not known about that release.

sections.title: Where to Buy
sections.content:
• PlayStation 5 - PlayStation Store, digital only until 2027
  • PC - Steam or Epic Games Store, same price on both
  • China - CNY 268 standard and CNY 328 deluxe on the domestic storefronts

Regional pricing varies, so the numbers above are list prices rather than promises. Store links, platform differences and the PS5 Pro situation are on the platforms page.

sections.title: Buying Questions
sections.content:
Can I still pre-order Phantom Blade Zero?

No. Pre-orders closed when the game released on 29 October 2026, but the game itself is on sale at the same price.

Is the pre-order bonus still available?

The Treasure Basin accessory is obtainable inside the game regardless of when you buy, so you have not missed a build-defining item.

How much does Phantom Blade Zero cost?

$59.99 in the US, GBP 49.99 in the UK and EUR 59.99 in the eurozone, with the Deluxe tier above that. In China it is CNY 268 standard and CNY 328 deluxe.

Should I wait for the physical edition?

Only if you specifically want a disc. The boxed PS5 version is a 2027 release with no date, and everything on sale now is digital.
